MASSIVE_EVIDENCE.forex_history: Custom historical OHLC available; documentation states history back to 2009-09-25 on the cited Forex aggregate page.
MASSIVE_EVIDENCE.forex_time_basis: Forex custom aggregate documentation states ET timestamps.
MASSIVE_EVIDENCE.precious_metals: Official Massive knowledge base documents spot gold as C:XAUUSD and spot silver as C:XAGUSD.
MASSIVE_EVIDENCE.indices: Official Massive documentation provides historical index OHLC and states NDX/Nasdaq Composite are covered; DJI is available but requires a paid indices tier.
MASSIVE_EVIDENCE.index_time_basis: Official Massive indices aggregate documentation states ET.
MASSIVE_EVIDENCE.index_sources: Official Massive source documentation states indices originate from Nasdaq, Cboe Global Indices, and CME Group and expose source_feed.
MASSIVE_EVIDENCE.missing_bar_semantics: Official aggregate documentation states no bar is produced when no qualifying update/trade occurs, preserving empty intervals.
MASSIVE_EVIDENCE.futures: Official futures docs support historical OHLC at resolutions from seconds through week/month and explicitly document session timing.
MASSIVE_EVIDENCE.authority_gap: Exact authoritative symbol mapping and entitlement/plan coverage for every research asset still require explicit verification before seal.

TWELVE_DATA_EVIDENCE.forex_history: Official Twelve Data documentation states 20+ years of forex history depending on pair and supports 1h, 1day, 1week and 1month intervals.
TWELVE_DATA_EVIDENCE.precious_metals: Official Twelve Data forex page explicitly lists Gold Spot XAU and Silver Spot XAG.
TWELVE_DATA_EVIDENCE.timezone: Official API documentation allows UTC for intraday output, but daily/weekly/monthly timezone parameter is ignored and returned in exchange local time.
TWELVE_DATA_EVIDENCE.timezone_documentation_conflict: Official support material states a default Forex timezone of Australia/Sydney, while API documentation describes forex timestamps as UTC; controlled timezone handling can mitigate this, but the discrepancy must be documented.
TWELVE_DATA_EVIDENCE.authority_gap: Exact index instrument mappings and uniform cross-asset calendar semantics remain unverified.
